SpaceX continues preparations for Starship Flights 16 and 17 at Starbase, with Ship 43 receiving engines inside Megabay 2, Ship 44 and Booster 24 completing cryogenic proof testing at Massey’s after rolling out this week, and Booster 25 advancing through stacking while the Gigabay reaches a major construction milestone with the removal of its final tower crane.

At the Launch Site, teams lower a work platform into the Pad 2 Launch Mount and perform maintenance on the chopsticks and Ship Quick Disconnect following the successful Ship 42 catch on Flight 15, as Pad 1 progresses with flame trench wall installations and continues toward eventual reactivation.
